items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I heard Buck Clayton playing it the other night... Buck Clayton was an arranger. He sat down with Buck. They would play them and tell him what he was playing

ctx.x: Well, you were doing waltzes before, right?

Well, we wasn't playin' no dances. Like, if you played a waltz, somebody's gonna dance a waltz or something like that. But I'm talking about in a band, you had to play a waltz if you played a dance, or people would think you was crazy. Because a lot of people liked to waltz, you know. The waltz was kind of a popular thing in them days. And you played tunes like "The Charleston" -- people were doing the Charleston then. And you played "I Want A Little Girl," all them tunes -- of course, they play them now. I heard…
